name: Phase A2: Chassis Clone Stage, Component Replacement, Template Generation, and Pipeline Validation Gates
deliverables: Chassis-clone stage: manifest-driven clone of all 67 chassis files, hash-verified at clone time (tamper = compile fail)
Component replacement: replace fallback layout files using blueprint components via section groups JSON type swap (no delete-and-inject)
Template generation: compile blueprint to templates/*.json, generating product template mapping to functional buy button forms and collection mapping to grids
Pipeline validation gates: compile-time linter (render-target check + forbidden filters) + shopify theme check integrated into compiler
acceptanceCriteria: ChassisTamperError test: temporarily modifying a chassis file during compile throws compile-halting error containing file path; restoring it compiles cleanly (performed on safe temp copy)

Layout swap (luxury header variant): fallback header.liquid is absent from the compiled output bundle; source base-theme remains untouched (hash-verified post-compile), and layout/theme.liquid section groups are swapped to point to the luxury variant
Layout swap (no component): compiled bundle keeps fallback header.liquid and section group points to fallback header (chassis renders alone check)

PDP static assertion: compiled main-product.liquid (or equivalent) contains {% form 'product' %}, submit button with name='add', variant ID input with name='id', and compiled templates/product.json references the section and contains the essential blocks (buy_buttons, title, price, variant_picker) dynamically verified against the section schema's actual defined block types
Collection static assertion: compiled main-collection.liquid contains pagination block and product-card render loop

Linter scope boundary: compile process blocks on render-target violations, forbidden filters (ternary, pluralize, color_modify), and shopify theme check errors (WCAG/CLS scanners excluded from compiler)
Source safety check: verify-registry runs and remains 100% green after compilation, proving the compiler operates read-only on all source files
Vitest test suite: includes tests for all positive/negative layout swaps, tamper checks, static assertions, and passes 100% green
